Overview
The Select Board consists of five members, with three members constituting a quorum. Members of the Select Board are elected by the registered voters of the Town of Athol. The Town Election is held annually on the first Monday in April.
The Select Board meets on the first and third Tuesday of each month at 7:00 p.m. in Room 21 of the Athol Memorial Building. Meetings are recorded by AOTV and are typically broadcast live on Channels 1301 and 1302 for Spectrum Cable subscribers. Meetings may also be streamed on televisions and personal devices. Additional streaming information is available at
AOTV13.org
.
Meeting agendas, documents, and minutes may be accessed through the
My Town Government
meeting site. In accordance with the Open Meeting Law, Boards and Committees are required to post meeting agendas at least 48 hours in advance. Requests to have an item placed on the agenda must be submitted to the Board Chair or the Executive Assistant by Thursday preceding a scheduled meeting. All agenda requests are subject to the discretion of the Chair.
